description: One card per active project in the caller's organization: latest audit health, rank-tracker status, and trailing-7-day web-analytics sessions. FREE: database only. No SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent — GSC and backlinks are deliberately excluded from this view rather than fetched live, so calling this never spends a Search Console quota unit or a paid-provider credit. `audit`/`rankTracking`/`webAnalytics` are null on a card whose project has none of that data yet (never audited, no tracker configured, no analytics traffic) — a real 'not set up' fact, not a zero standing in for missing data.
name: get_dashboard
